costs.fee_model: edge_lab.fees v1: model fee = fee_multiplier (1 for KXHIGHNY) * 0.07 * C * P * (1 - P); trade fee = ceil to $0.000001; cash change = floor to the cent of (-P*C - trade fee) (non-direct member); taker only; no maker fills, no rounding rebates, no settlement fee assumed. Evidence: gate3/evidence/kalshi_docs_fee_rounding.html, kalshi_series_KXHIGHNY.json
costs.spread: Crossed in full: YES bought at 1 - best NO bid, NO bought at 1 - best YES bid, from the captured book; never mid or last price

frozen_fields.decision_time: 18:00 America/New_York on D-1 for target date D (UTC via the US DST rule, edge_lab.dataset_exp001.decision_time). Forecast availability cutoff = decision - 30 min: use the latest PFMOKX issuance (WMO header time, within 0-15 min after its local issuance line) with issuance <= cutoff, a Central Park max for D, and age <= 24 h at the cutoff; nothing issued later is ever used; suffixed products (CCx/RRx/AAx) are never used; same-minute latest products that disagree exclude the row (ADR 0010).
frozen_fields.economic_rationale:
Retail-heavy weather markets may misprice short-horizon temperature risk relative to
professional numerical forecasts, or react slowly to forecast updates. The rationale is
unproven. The null hypothesis is that prices already reflect public NWS forecasts.

execution.fill_model: Stage B only: order book captured in [decision - 5 min, decision] (else NO_BOOK, no trade); 1 contract at the implied ask, size must be <= displayed size; fill counts only if a book captured 10-15 min later still offers <= entry price with size >= 1 (else NO_FILL_UNVERIFIED); no retroactive fills; settle with settlement.resolve on the official label
execution.latency: 10 minutes (fill confirmation window 10-15 min after the decision snapshot)

failure_criteria: Stage A fails if either Stage A condition fails; then Stage B is not run for this model
Stage B fails at a look (180th or 365th valid day) if the 97.5% block-bootstrap upper bound of mean daily net P&L < 0, or if Stage A failed (then Stage B is not run for this model)
Stage B is INCONCLUSIVE if neither PASS nor FAIL holds at the 365th valid day; no other looks are taken
Any result that depends on mid-price, last-price, stale-book or retroactive fills is void
features: forecast_max_f: the NWS PFM Central Park daytime max for D from the issuance selected by the availability rule
meteorological season of D (DJF/MAM/JJA/SON), V2 only
bracket bounds from captured market fields strike_type/floor_strike/cap_strike, checked against rules text (settlement.resolve), Stage B only
frozen_fields.hypothesis:
At a fixed decision time before the market closes, a calibrated probability for each
KXHIGHNY bracket, derived only from NWS forecasts available at that time, differs from the
executable Kalshi ask/bid by more than fees plus spread, often enough and by enough to have
positive expected value after costs.

Tested in two separate stages. Stage A (historical, data exist): the forecast-derived
probabilities are informative and calibrated on a held-out period; a prerequisite, not
evidence of an edge. Stage B (prospective shadow trading, data do not exist yet): the
probabilities beat executable prices after fees.
frozen_fields.market: Kalshi KXHIGHNY (Highest temperature in NYC), daily brackets
frozen_fields.model: Empirical integer error pmf: P(y = f + k) = (n_k + 0.5) / (N + 0.5*41), k in [-20, 20] (outside errors counted/scored at +-20), f = forecast_max_f. Variants exactly two: V1 pooled; V2 one pmf per meteorological season of D. Fit on usable train days for validation scoring; selected variant refit once on train+validation for test scoring; refit once on all usable days through 2026-09-21 for Stage B. Selection: V2 only if mean validation per-day log-score difference (V2 - V1) > 0 and its 95% block-bootstrap lower bound > 0, else V1. Bracket probability = pmf summed over integers that settlement.resolve maps to YES. References: R0 monthly climatology (add-0.5 over integer support [min label - 10, max label + 10] of the fit window); R1 discretized Gaussian N(f + mu, sigma^2) from fit-window errors, prob floor 1e-9 (reported only). Bootstrap everywhere: edge_lab.stats.block_bootstrap_mean_ci as frozen (circular moving blocks of 7 days, starts random.Random(20260922).randrange(n), ceil(n/7) blocks truncated to n, 10000 resamples, bounds m[floor(alpha/2*B)] and m[ceil((1-alpha/2)*B)-1], alpha 0.05 unless stated; per-day values of usable days in date order). Full spec: gate3/DESIGN.md section 5.

periods.stage_b: from the first valid decision day after the freeze; looks at exactly the 180th and 365th valid decision days

risk_constraints: Research only: no orders, no credentials, no funded account, no order-execution code
Stage B is shadow only; it simulates fills from captured books under the execution model and never sends orders
Test split is evaluated exactly once, after this freeze, with nothing changed; any later change is a new experiment
success_criteria: Stage A (historical probability validation, test 2025-01-01..2026-09-21, evaluated once in Gate 4): mean per-day log-score difference (selected model - R0) > 0 with the 95% block-bootstrap lower bound > 0, AND randomized-PIT central-80% coverage (u = F(y-1) + v*P(y), v from random.Random(20260922) in date order; fraction with 0.10 <= u <= 0.90) within [0.75, 0.85]. A Stage A pass is NOT evidence of a trading edge.

Stage B (prospective shadow trading, BLOCKED-ON-OWNER for scheduled collection): signal 'buy 1 YES if p - cost_yes >= 0.05; buy 1 NO if (1 - p) - cost_no >= 0.05' (cost = fees.cost_per_contract(1, ask)). Valid decision day = books stored in [decision - 5 min, decision] plus a re-check snapshot 10-15 min later; daily value = sum of net P&L of filled trades, 0 on a valid day with no signal or no fill. Exactly two looks, at the 180th and 365th valid day, each with a 97.5% block-bootstrap interval (alpha 0.025, Bonferroni). PASS at a look: mean daily net P&L > 0 and lower bound > 0 (SHADOW_POSITIVE, not EDGE_PROVEN).
